title: DSH Superagent: Attention-Minimizing Proactive Agent Philosophy
summary: Proactive coding agents must minimize human attention cost: act only on explicit request or written team rules, confirm once, stay silent while working, ask one concrete structured question at a time, and stop by impact rather than effort.
